statement: Call coordination slot acquisition and completion scale linearly in partition count: fresh-slot acquisition is a single-row claim with a guarded read-back and the complete-set read is index-served, replacing the two-full-slot-reads-per-slot shape — proven by benchmark statement counts measured at 8, 64, and 256 partitions before and after, with correctness unchanged, and the call-coordination-linear-cost scenario is green.

constraints.statement: Statement-count benchmarks at 8/64/256 partitions are recorded before the change; the optimization is accepted only against that baseline with unchanged coordination semantics.
Claim, completion, and visibility semantics of the coordination grammar are byte-identical; only the access path cost changes.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
